DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

Given your age of 69 and the classic presentation of a new headache with progressive vision loss over three weeks, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate evaluation for temporal arteritis. Please hold on while I request urgent blood tests to check for elevated inflammatory markers.
